name: website
title: Website
summary: Pages that load fast, read well on a phone and never break a link.

rules.text: Every page reads in full with JavaScript turned off.
rules.why: search engines, slow phones and screen readers often meet a page before its scripts run.

rules.text: No change leaves a link pointing at a missing page.
rules.why: a broken link is a dead end for every reader who follows it.
